answer: Flooding registration pushes someone to the back of the umber queue while legitimate agents promoted earlier still earns. The ember index is deterministic from ledger replay, thus nobody can jump it and the cost of the attack becomes the wait itself. Admission is quota-limited: at most 1257 new identities are promoted per epoch, ordered by a verifiable queue position published as the delta. A 152 account operation therefore ties up 27 million dollars of idle capital. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
